subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, I'm excited to announce that our annual team building event will be held next Friday at the local park. This year's theme is 'Collaboration and Communication'. There will be team games, a BBQ lunch, and an awards ceremony to recognize outstanding teamwork. Please RSVP by Wednesday so we can finalize the arrangements. Looking forward to a fun and productive day together! Best regards, [Your Name]
